column1: # type:     OWN_BRAND | OWN_PRODUCT | BANK | BROKER | REGULATOR | STATE_ENTITY
# Institution types (OWN_*, REGULATOR, STATE_ENTITY, PAYMENT_NETWORK, BANK, BROKER) also match
# inside a longer handle, so a name carried alongside a staff role is refused. ISSUER and
# POLITICAL_PARTY match only as a whole name: following or discussing an issuer or a party is not
# a claim to be one, so "tesla_investor" and "musavat_reader" stay ordinary handles.
# The seed is versioned data, not code. Skeletons are computed by HandleSkeleton at load time so
# the registry can never drift from the folding the gateway applies to an incoming handle.
# Operator: ABB Invest (abbinvest.az), a product of ABB / Azerbaijan International Bank
# (abb-bank.az). OWN_BRAND and OWN_PRODUCT are exclusive: no member handle may contain them, even
# inside a longer handle. Official ABB accounts are therefore provisioned through
# Current member handles are managed outside this moderation service.
# DEPLOYMENT INPUT: extend OWN_PRODUCT with any further ABB product, campaign, or sub-brand name
# before launch. A missing product name leaves that identity open to impersonation.
# --- Operator brand combined with a staff role ---
# These are listed explicitly because the bare "ABB" skeleton folds to two characters, which is
# below the length a containment match is allowed to use. Without these rows, "abb_destek" and
# "abb_support" would reach the model instead of being refused deterministically. Each entry also
# covers one-edit variants through near matching.
# --- Other banks operating in Azerbaijan (ABB is OWN_BRAND above, not listed here) ---
# --- Azerbaijani state bodies, state holdings, and state-owned companies ---
# Impersonating a state issuer on an investment platform is a market-integrity risk, not only an
# identity one: a fake announcement from one of these names moves prices. Institution type, so a
# handle carrying the name alongside a staff role is refused.
# --- Card schemes, payment networks, and transfer operators ---
# Credential-collection handles are the common abuse here, so these are institution type.
# Treated as brokers rather than issuers: support-desk impersonation is the dominant phishing
# NOT institution type. Members legitimately follow and discuss these names, so only the whole
# name is refused; "tesla_investor" and "apple_fan" stay ordinary handles.
# POLICY INPUT: listed uniformly, never selectively. Protecting one party's name while leaving
# another claimable is itself a political act. NOT institution type: commentary about a party is
# not a claim to be it, so only the whole name is refused. Remove this whole block, or extend it
# with every registered party, but do not curate it partially.
